cap.rule: k = min(1.0, beta_target / beta) -- de-risking only, never leverage
cap.sentence: under the estimator production actually uses (expanding beta, its minimum over the whole path is 0.42) the clip never meets its edge in 1531 decision bars -- there is no leverage to withhold; under the fixed-window estimator the clip fires on 17 of 68 readings (2024-08-22..2025-12-18, k_raw up to 2.9509, withholding up to 93.222pp of risk) and removing it would have bought 9.693pp of CAGR with -0.0099 of Sharpe over MDD -11.015pp -> CAP_COSTS_NOTHING_RISK_ADJUSTED.

window_estimator_arm.note: this estimator does not size the book; it is reported because the desk has been arguing about the window, not about the engine rule

sentence: the floor is signed by a 306-bar window and the reading carries 10.43pp of its own k-noise, so the band is fixed at +/-10.43pp (warn at 20.86pp, refuse beyond) and the window may change only by amendment; under the production estimator the de-lever-only clip binds on 0.0% of decision bars (None..None) and never in 2020_2022, 2023, 2026, while under the floor's own window estimator it binds 17 times -- its removal is CAP_NEVER_BINDS on the estimator that actually sizes the book

window_pin.why: the reading carries 10.43pp of its own k-noise; re-choosing the window inside that noise is arithmetic below the ruler's resolution
